analysis.rationale: 3-step deterministic pipeline, no noise. JPEG: block_boundary=3.201 (0%FP signal) + dct_zero_ratio=0.903; severity scan jpeg 3/4/5 peaking at 4 (28.67/34.83/26.05 dB; block_boundary diff 0%). Brightness: mean_shift=+24/255=0.094 (all channels same direction), run_full_analysis suppressed it only by the brightness_from_jpeg FP rule; deterministic shift c=0.10 (sev1 = +25.5) matches; severity/variant scans: shift_RGB:1 34.83 outranks gamma_RGB:2 28.62, gamma_RGB:1 26.89, shift_RGB:2 25.37, shift_HSV:1 29.25. Order: blur -> brightness -> JPEG (34.83, CI 10/10) beats blur -> JPEG -> brightness (34.10, CI 7/10) and brightness-before-blur (24.62). Blur: DT said glass (score=1.02, medium), but PSNR arbitration picks lens; severity scan lens 3/4/5 = 30.10/34.83/29.08 under best combo, gaussian:4 = 30.49. Blur subtype marked UNCERTAIN (glass DT vs lens PSNR, gaussian/lens MTF ambiguity; pair0 PSNR 34.83 in 30-40 band). Noise: peeled (correct pipeline) sigma=1.48 < 2, extreme_pct=92.14% with zero_ratio=0.8443 is documented JPEG/clipping FP; no noise step. Support validation (k=3, all pairs): pair0 34.83 dB CI 10/10; pair1 38.34 dB CI 10/10; pair2 43.15 dB CI 10/10 (ACCEPT).

support_validation.note: Identical pipeline applied to all 3 support pairs; all pass CI 10/10, pair2 above 40dB.
